title: GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.20524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. translated_title: GaugeRoPE：与RoPE兼容的可执行潜在注意力
translated_abstract: 潜在KV缓存压缩通过将历史键与值映射为紧凑表示来减少内存占用。然而，通用的压缩键状态在应用RoPE并计算注意力得分之前，需要先重构回原始维度，这给解码路径带来了随序列长度扩展的开销。我们刻画了潜在KV表示在何种条件下可以直接充当预训练RoPE的执行状态。对于基于RoPE的Transformer而言，旋转键路径的精确静态线性执行要求从潜在空间到原始空间的映射通过一个交织关系来保持预训练的RoPE作用，这将精确混合限制在共享同一RoPE频率的坐标之间。基于这一刻画，我们构建了GaugeRoPE——一种无需训练的可执行潜在KV表示。它将一个能够保持旋转作用的RoPE兼容载体与一个近似的、与位置无关的残差键值（RKV）修正相结合，以补……
tldr: 提出无需训练的可执行潜在KV表示GaugeRoPE，其RoPE兼容载体可在压缩键上直接执行预训练旋转注意力而无需重构回原始维度，从而消除了解码路径中随序列长度扩展的开销。
en_tdlr: GaugeRoPE is a training-free executable latent KV representation whose RoPE-compatible carrier directly executes pretrained rotary attention on compressed keys without reconstruction, eliminating sequence-scaling overhead in the decode path.
